summary: Added goal done-message inline buttons (Test Detail + Incorporate Feedback), wired gTD/gIF callback handlers, persisted chat/thread-scoped telegramDoneMessage and telegramFeedbackPromptMessages, added /goal_feedback command plumbing, extended goal router with GOAL_FEEDBACK reply routing, updated bot handler dispatch + run scoping, and added/updated tests for keyboard/callback/routing plus run-store round-trip preservation. Verified with pnpm vitest run src/telegram/goal-commands.test.ts src/telegram/goal-router.test.ts src/telegram/bot-handlers.goal-routing.test.ts, pnpm vitest run src/goal/run-store.test.ts, pnpm lint, and pnpm build.
